race.comment: BALANCE (5) got the job done first up as a short priced favourite at Geelong, sent out the $1.65 elect and just proving a bit too good late. Suspect there's more to offer now and she should get a lovely run just behind the speed again. NEZIHA (9) resumes. She was beaten as favourite in her only run last time in and spelled but had shown good ability in her maiden campaign and warrants plenty of respect. TWO TO TANGO (8) has the ability to run well fresh and draws for a nice run, she ran in some better races last campaign but do fancy 1200m will be on the sharp side. TOUGH ROMANCE (10) can improve third up to 1200m and should give a sight on speed.
